baseline_lock.causal_latency_matched_persistence: latest outlet observation available under the registered one-hour publication-lag assumption, held constant to each horizon
baseline_lock.zero_latency_archive_persistence: outlet archive observation whose support ends at issue time, held constant; diagnostic only and unavailable under the lag assumption

forbidden_after_freeze: assimilate observations after issue time within a horizon rollout
replace unavailable operational inputs with realized future values
drop finite rows based on error

forecast_cycle_lock.branch_rollout: clone each scenario analysis at issue time and execute one continuous 24-hour rollout, recording registered intermediate horizons
forecast_cycle_lock.cycling_state: each scenario advances one hour between issue times using only its registered issue-time observations

horizon_lock.target_definition: outlet mean discharge over the final hourly interval ending issue_time_plus_horizon

required_missing_inputs: historical issue-time NWM forcing forecast vintages
historical issue-time reservoir release plan vintages
verified historical USGS observation publication vintages

retrospective_oracle_forcing.action: realized CWMS hourly release for every future interval
retrospective_oracle_forcing.forcing: NWM v3 retrospective q_lateral for every future interval
retrospective_oracle_forcing.reason: future action and forcing are realized retrospective values, not issue-time forecast vintages

outcome_access_at_freeze.reason: same window was already scored by the one-step diagnostic

scientific_role: post-outcome development re-analysis of one already exposed window; not prospective validation

scoring_and_gate_lock.development_gate: all four core horizons pass without compensation
scoring_and_gate_lock.mass_gate: every executed scenario step within numeric tolerance
scoring_and_gate_lock.operational_gate: unassessable until all required forecast vintages exist
scoring_and_gate_lock.per_core_horizon_gate: graph RMSE strictly below local multi-gauge, outlet-only, and causal latency-matched persistence RMSE
